title: CRLR/199/2014 of Amit Kumar Vs Sarita Devi

paras.text:
CRLR No. 199 of 2014
With
CRLR No. 79 of 2013
C482 No. 1149 of 2014
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Atul Kumar Bansal, Advocate for the
revisionist.
Mr. Balvinder Singh, Advocate for the
respondent.
Parties were referred to the Mediation Centre
of this Court to explore the possibility of mutual
settlement in view of the fact that all the cases are
arising out of the matrimonial dispute. As per the
report of the learned Mediator dated 17.06.2015,
duly signed by the parties, it seems that parties have
settled their dispute amicably.
Learned counsel, appearing for the parties,
submitted that since parties have settled their
dispute amicably, therefore, no useful purpose
would be served in keeping the prosecution alive.
Therefore, Criminal Revision Nos. 199 of
2014 and 79 of 2013 stand disposed of in terms of
the mutual settlement and report of the Mediator.
Entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 5 of
2013, Smt. Sarita Devi Vs. Amit Kumar, under
Section 12 of the Protection of Women from
Domestic Violence Act, 2005, stands quashed, in
view of the mutual settlement arrived at between the
parties.
C482 No. 1149 of 2014 also stands disposed
of accordingly.
Let copy of the order be forwarded to the
learned Trial Court for information and compliance.
Let copy of this order be placed in connected
matters.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
Dated 14.10.2015
Shiv
